t: Din yisrael venokri sheyyesh lahem shuttaput
s: Din yisrael venokri sheyyesh lahem shuttaput ubo k"z seipim: yisrael shellava kikkar shel chametz mechabero velo para lo ad shehiggia happesach — chayyab liproa lo leachar happesach, veyesh bo mishshum gazel im eno porea lo, kevan shehilva lo bishat hetter. Veim ba liproa lo betok happesach bemaot o bishar debarim — rashshay hammalveh leqabbelam mimmennu velehanot mehem apillu bepesach. Veap al pi shehu lava mimmennu kikkar shel chametz sheyyipra lo kikkar shel chametz, venimtza shemmaot ellu hen chalipe hakkikkar shel chametz shehu chayyab liproa lo, veasur lehanot mechalipe chametz bepesach apillu leachar happesach kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"g, mikkol maqom kevan shebbeshaa shehalloveh porea hammaot lehammalveh en birshut halloveh shum kikkar shel chametz sheyyukal litteno lehammalveh bepiron chobo, lekak en shem chalipin niqra al maot hallalu, shellashon chalipin eno nopel ella keshemmachalip dabar al dabar shehu beayin:

Vaapillu im yesh kikkarot shel chametz beayin birshut halloveh beshaa shehu porea hammaot lehammalveh betok happesach, kegon shehalloveh hu nokri, ap al pi ken muttar lehammalveh leqabbel mimmennu hammaot bead hakkikkar shehu chayyab lo. Ap al pi shekkebar abar miqtzat happesach al kikkar zeh shehu chayyab veneesar bahanaa im haya birshut hayyisrael vegam chalipayv hayu asurin kedin chametzo shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, mikkol maqom akshav shehu birshut hannokri dino kachametzo shel nokri sheabar alayv happesach. Veap al pi shehu meshubad leyisrael, shehare lava mimmennu kikkar sheyyipra lo kikkar, mikkol maqom kevan shello nityached shibudo al kikkarot ellu shemmunnachim birshut hannokri bepesach, shehare hannokri yakol liqnot kikkar min hashshuq veliproa lo chobo, vekikkarot ellu shemmunnachim birshuto bepesach yakol hu leoklam ulehotziam lekol mah sheyyirtzeh shello middaat hayyisrael, nimtza sheen leyisrael shum zekiyya bakkikkarot hammunnachim birshut hannokri bepesach sheyyihyu neesarin mishshum chametzo shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, veen lo al hannokri ella chob shel chametz bilbad, vehachob shel chametz eno neesar mechamat sheabar alayv happesach, kevan sheggup hechametz hu shel nokri, veen lehayyisrael shum zekiyya bo:

Umittaam zeh yisrael shehilva maot lenokri beribbit shel chametz, shekkol zeman shello yipra lo maotayv yitten lo bekol shabua veshabua kamma kikkarot shel chametz — muttar lo leqabbel min hannokri leachar happesach et hakkikkarot shemmaggia lo bead shabua shel pesach. Vaapillu noten lo kikkarot shennitchammetzu bepesach o shennitchammetzu qodem happesach vahare hen chametz sheabar alayv happesach, mikkol maqom kevan shekkol yeme happesach hayu birshut hannokri velo haya lehayyisrael shum zekiyya bahen — hare dinam kachametzo shel nokri sheabar alayv happesach. Ulepi sheyyesh choleqin al taam zeh, lepikak lekattechilla tzarik lehatnot im hannokri qodem happesach shello yitten lo leachar happesach bead shabua shel pesach kikkarot shennitchammetzu bepesach o qodem happesach, ella yitten lo maot o qemach o kikkarot shennitchammetzu leachar happesach, kede shekkol yeme happesach lo yihyeh lo shum shibud al chametzo shel hannokri, vekevan shehitna immo tenay zeh, apillu im leachar happesach noten lo hannokri kikkarot shennitchammetzu bepesach o qodem happesach — muttar lo leqabbelam mimmennu uleoklam, lepi shekkikkarot hallalu hen chalipe hammaot shehitna immo latet lo bead shabua shel pesach. Abal bediabad shello hitna immo tenay zo qodem happesach uleachar happesach hebi lo hannokri bead shabua shel pesach kikkarot shennitchammetzu bepesach — muttar lo leqabbelam uleoklam, shehaiqqar kassebara harishona:

Veken haddin beyisrael sheqqana choq hakkomarim (perush shehammelek noten lakkomarim lechem chuqqam bekol shabua veshabua, vehen makeru leyisrael bitchillat hashshana kol hallechem sheyyinnaten lahem bekol shabua veshabua kol hashshana), shellekattechilla tzarik lizzaher sheyyatneh immahem qodem happesach shelleachar happesach lo yittenu lo bead shabua shel pesach lechem chametz shennitchammetz betok happesach, ella maot o shear dabar sheeno chametz o chametz shennitchammetz leachar happesach, ukeshemmatneh immahem kak, ap im leachar happesach yittenu lo hakkomarim bead shabua shel pesach lechem chametz shennitchammetz betok happesach — yihyeh muttar lo leqabbelo uleoklo. Ubediabad shello hitna immahem kelum, uleachar happesach natenu lo bead shabua shel pesach lechem chametz shennitchammetz betok happesach — muttar lo leqabbelo uleoklo mittaam shennitbaer:

Yisrael sheyyesh lo tannur veapa bo nokri chametz bepesach shello middaat hayyisrael — asur lo leqabbel maot min hannokri bead sekar hattannur apillu leachar happesach. Veim abar veqibbel maot min hannokri apillu betok happesach — muttar lo lehanot mehem. Ap al pi shehannokri noten lo maot ellu bead apiyyat hechametz sheapa betannuro bepesach beshaa shehechametz asur bahanaa, venimtza shehu neheneh meissure hanaa, mikkol maqom kevan shemmaot ellu enan lo deme hechametz velo chalipe hechametz, ella shechametz gorem lammaot sheyyabou leyad hayyisrael, lepikak en kan issur min hattora ella middibre soperim, sheasur lehistakker beissure hanaa lekattechilla, ulekak aseru leqabbel hammaot lekattechilla, abal im kebar qibbelam — lo qenasuhu lehapsid maotayv, ella biskar yen nesek bilbad, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman ql"g. Abal im hebi hannokri leachar happesach bead sekar hattannur kikkarot shel chametz sheapa otam bepesach betannuro shel yisrael, apillu abar hayyisrael veqibbelam — asur lo ulekol yisrael lehanot mehem, dekevan shedderek kol sokere tannur litten lebaal hattannur biskaro kikkar min hakkikkarot sheopin betannuro, nimtza shebbeshaa sheapa hannokri betannur shel yisrael kebar zaka hayyisrael bekikkar min hakkikkarot shel nokri sheapa otan battannur, vahare zeh chametzo shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, sheasur bahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael:

Lepikak, yisrael venokri sheyyesh lahem tannur beshuttaput — lo yomar lehannokri: "tol atta bilbaddeka sekar hattannur mimmah sheyyopu bo hannokrim chametz bashshabua shel pesach vaani ettol bilbaddi keneged zeh shabua shelleachar happesach", dekevan sheyyesh leyisrael cheleq begup hattannur, im ken mittechillat hashshuttaput zaka hayyisrael bemachatzit hechametz sheyyeqabbel hannokri bead sekar hattannur bepesach, umah sheomer lehannokri achar kak sheyyittol hu bilbaddo bashshabua shel pesach vehu yittol kenegdo bashshabua shelleachar happesach — hare zeh kemachalip chametzo shezzaka bo bepesach al chametz acher. Veen hetter ella shebbitchillat hashshuttaput yatneh im hannokri sheyyittol hu bilbaddo bashshabua shel pesach vehu yittol kenegdo bashshabua shelleachar happesach, denimtza shello zaka hayyisrael meolam bemachatzit hechametz shel pesach, kevan shekkebar silleq et atzmo mimmennu bitchillat hashshuttaput:

Veim lo hitna immo kak bitchillat hashshuttaput (veayyen besiman rm"h sheyyesh od taqqana lazeh) — yesh lo taqqana sheqqodem happesach yimkor et machatzit hattannur shello lehannokri al kol yeme happesach, dehaynu shekkol yeme happesach yihyeh kol gup hattannur shel hannokri viqabbel damim min hannokri bead machatzit tannuro qodem happesach, o yaqneh lehannokri et machatzit tannuro beechad middarke haqqeniyya sheyyitbaaru bechoshen mishpat hilkot miqqach umimkar, veyatneh immo shelleachar happesach yitten lo bead machatzito maot o sheare debarim sheenan chametz o chametz shennitchammetz leachar happesach, ukeshehitna immo kak ap im leachar happesach noten lo hannokri lechem chametz shenneepa bepesach betannuro — muttar lo leqabbelo uleoklo, shehare lo zaka hayyisrael belechem zeh qodem shennetano hannokri leyado, kevan shehitna immo sheyyitten lo maot o sheare debarim:

Asur lehaskir lenokri chamor leholik alayv chametz bepesach, o cheder lasum betoko chametz bepesach, mippene sheasur lehistakker beissure hanaa. Abal muttar lehaskir lo chamor al shabua shel pesach bistam, sheen hannokri meparesh lo sheyyolik alayv chametz bepesach. Ap al pi shehu yodea shehannokri yolik alayv chametz — en bekak kelum, dekevan sheap im lo yolik alayv kelum yitztarek liproa leyisrael kol sekaro mishshalem, kevan shehiskiro lo leshabua, ben sheyyolik alayv kol yeme hashshabua (chutz mishshabbat veyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besiman rm"v), ben shello yolik alayv kelal, im ken en hayyisrael mistakker kelum bemah shehannokri molik alayv chametz bepesach:

Veken muttar lehaskir lo cheder sheyyadur bo bepesach, ap al pi sheyyadua sheyyaknis letoko chametz, mikkol maqom hayyisrael eno notel mimmennu sekar haknasat hechametz ella sekar haddira, sheap im lo yaknis chametz letoko kol yeme happesach lo yenakkeh lo kelum missekaro:

Abal asur lehaskir lo tannur leepot bo bepesach, ap al pi sheen hannokri meparesh lo sheyyopeh bo chametz, mikkol maqom setam apiyyat hannokri hu chametz, vahare zeh kimparesh lo sheyyopeh bo chametz, venireh kemistakker beissure hanaa. Lepikak, tzarik hayyisrael lehatnot im hannokri beshaa shemmaskir lo shello yopeh bo chametz bepesach, ella yebashshel bo tabshilo veyopeh bo matztza, ukeshemmatneh immo kak ap al pi shehannokri opeh bo chametz bepesach — en tzarik limchot beyado. Umuttar leqabbel mimmennu sekar hattannur apillu betok happesach, veen zeh mistakker beissure hanaa, kevan sheap im lo haya hannokri opeh bo kelum haya tzarik liproa leyisrael kol sekaro mishshalem, shehare hiskiro lo leshabua, ben yopeh bo harbeh ben lo yopeh bo kelum, im ken en hayyisrael mistakker kelum bemah shehannokri opeh bo chametz. Ella shellekattechilla tzarik lehatnot immo kak, kede shello yehe nireh kemistakker beissure hanaa, kevan shehaddabar yadua sheen hannokri soker hattannur ella kede leepot bo chametz:

Vekol zeh keshemmaskir lo betok happesach o beereb pesach apillu qodem shaa chamishit, abal qodem ereb pesach muttar lehaskir lenokri ben chamor ben tannur ben cheder, ap al pi shehannokri meparesh lo sheyyishtammesh bahen chametz bepesach veal menat ken hu sokeram mimmennu, dekevan shehannokri yakol lehishtammesh yom echad bahem chametz bishat hetter, dehaynu mishshaa shemmaskiram lo ad shaa shishshit beereb pesach, im ken hassakar shennotel mimmennu hayyisrael eno nikkar venireh shehu bead sheat issur, dehaynu bead shabua shel pesach, ella bead sheat hetter, dehaynu bead mah shehannokri yakol lehishtammesh bahen chametz mishshaa shemmaskiram lo ad shaa shishshit beereb pesach:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bachamor vecheder vetannur vekayyotze bahen, sheen shum hanaa maggaat leyisrael mimmah shehannokri yishtammesh bahen chametz bepesach, abal asur lehaskir lenokri keli shemmebashshelin bo al gabbe haur, kegon qedera veyora vekayyotze bahen, apillu kamma yamim qodem happesach im yadua lo sheyyebashshel bo chametz bepesach, ap al pi sheen hannokri meparesh lo sheyyebashshel bo chametz. Vaapillu lehashil lo bechinnam asur, lepi sheim yebashshel bo chametz bepesach yaggia lehayyisrael hanaa mehechametz, shehare im hannokri haya meareh min hakkeli et hechametz shemmitbashshel betoko al gabbe haur vehaya hakkeli nishar reqan al gabbe haur haya hakkeli mitbaqqea mechamat haur, veakshav shehechametz mitbashshel betoko al gabbe haur en hakkeli mitbaqqea, nimtza shemmaggia leyisrael qetzat hanaa mehechametz bepesach. Abal im en yadua lanu shehannokri yebashshel bo chametz — muttar lehaskir lo apillu betok happesach. Ap al pi shehakkeli lo hukshar leshem pesach, vahare hu balua mechametz harbeh sheasur bahanaa, mikkol maqom gup hakkeli lo neesar bahanaa, veen hannokri soker mimmennu venoten lo damim bead hechametz habbalua bakkeli ella bead gup hakkeli hammuttar bahanaa:

Umittaam zeh muttar lehachem chammin bepesach bikli habbalua mechametz kede lehishtammesh bechammin ellu lirchitza velikbisa velachop bahen et harosh, shehare eno neheneh ella min hakkeli velo min chametz habbalua betoko, ap al pi shehu niplat min hakkeli letok chammin hallalu veyesh bahen taam hechametz, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno omed lishtiyya ella lirchitza ukebisa hare eno neheneh kelum min taam hechametz shenniplat letokan. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bikli hamyuchad lirchitza velikbisa sheen derek lehishtammesh bo laakila velishtiyya, abal keli shedderek lehishtammesh bo lipamim laakila ushetiyya — tzarik lehatznio bemaqom tzanua sheeno ragil lelek lesham kol yeme happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"a, veen lehishtammesh bo apillu lirchitza ukebisa, vaapillu al yede tzonen, gezera shemma yishkach veyishtammesh bo laakila ushetiyya. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesherotzeh lehishtammesh bo bepesach biqbiut, abal lehishtammesh bo derek aray bemiqreh al yede tzonen — muttar apillu letzorek akila ushetiyya im eno keli cheres, o apillu al yede chammin letzorek rechitza ukebisa apillu hu keli cheres, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"a, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Mi shemmachaziq yorot mimmoshel hair veyesh lo choq qabua mehammoshel al kol bene hair shekkol mi shemmebashshel beyorot ellu tzarik litten lo midda achat mikkol bishshul, im hu beinyan shekkeshemmityashshenim hayyorot o shemmitqalqelin tzarik yisrael zeh hannotel sekaran letaqqenam o laasot chadashim — hare yorot ellu hen keshello mammash, veasur lo lehanniach lehannokrim sheyyebashshelu bahen chametz bepesach mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Veim en lo koach limnoa otan vehen mebashshelin chametz beal korcho — al kol panim asur lo littol leachar happesach et hammiddot shel bishshule chametz shehiprishu hannokrim bead sekar hayyorot shebbishshelu bahen chametz bepesach. Vaapillu im abar o shakach venatal middot ellu — asur lehanot mehen, dekevan sheddarkan leolam latet midda min habbishshul bead sekar hayyorot — hare zaka hayyisrael bemidda zo bishat habbishshul betok happesach, venaasa chametzo shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach. Vaapillu maot asur lo leqabbel leachar happesach bead sekar hayyorot shebbishshelu bahen chametz bepesach, kede shello yistakker beissure hanaa. Ella sheim abar veqibbelam — muttar lo lehanot mehem, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veketzad yaaseh yisrael zeh kesheyyaggia happesach? Yimkor lenokri al kol yeme happesach et kol hayyorot im kol hammiddot beechad middarke haqqeniyya shennitbaaru bechoshen mishpat hilkot miqqach umimkar, veyatneh immo shelleachar happesach yitten lo bead zeh maot o sheare debarim. Ukeshemmatneh immo kak, ap im leachar happesach noten lo hannokri et hammiddot shel chametz sheqqibbel bepesach biskar hayyorot — muttar lo leqabbelam uleoklam, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Abal im eno muttal al hayyisrael letaqqen hayyorot keshemmitqalqelin o keshemmityashshenin — hare hen birshut hammoshel, veen hayyisrael muzhar shello yebashshelu bahen nokrim chametz bepesach, shehare en lo shum hanaa min hechametz hammitbashshel betokan, sheap im yinnatel hechametz mittokan veyishshaaru reqanin al gabbe haur veyitbaqqeu lo yitztarek hayyisrael letaqqenan. Veim hu yodea umakkir et hannokrim sheyyebashshelu chametz bepesach — yatneh immahem qodem happesach shelleachar happesach yittenu lo bead sekar hayyorot maot o sheare debarim sheeno chametz, o chametz shennitchammetz leachar happesach, kede shekkol yeme happesach lo yihyeh lehayyisrael shum chob shel chametz. Ukeshehitna immahem tenay zeh, ap im leachar happesach notenim lo hannokrim hammiddot min habbishshulim shel chametz shebbishshelu bepesach — muttar lo leqabbelam. Veen zeh mistakker beissure hanaa, kevan sheggup hayyorot hen shel hammoshel legamre, veen lehayyisrael shum zekiyya bahen, shello sakar gup hayyorot ella choq hammaggia bilbad, vehannokrim hambashshelim enan notenin mah shennotenin ella bead sekar hayyorot shebbishshelu bahen et hechametz, vekevan shehayyorot hen shel hammoshel nimtza shehammoshel zaka biskaran miyyad shebbishshelu bahen, vehu hammistakker beissure hanaa, vehayyisrael chozer vezokeh min hammoshel, veeno mistakker kelal bead issure hanaa, ella bead hammaot shennatan o sheyyitten lehammoshel:

Abal bediabad sheabar o shakach velo hitna immahem tenay zeh qodem happesach uleachar happesach notenin lo hannokrim hammiddot min habbishshulim shel chametz shebbishshelu bepesach — muttar lo leqabbelam. Veken im eno yodea ezeh nokri yebashshel chametz bepesach sheyyatneh immo tenay zeh qodem happesach — hare zeh kediabad. Umikkol maqom, im epshar, tob limkor lenokri qodem happesach kol hammiddot shel pesach sheyyaprishu hambashshelim bepesach al derek shennitbaer lemala, o yetzavveh lannokrim hamshortim bebet hayyorot umemunnim lehaprish hammiddot min habbishshulim shello yaprishu kelum mibbishshul chametz sheyyebashshelu bepesach, ella yiktebu sham hambashshelim veyigbu mehen hammiddot leachar happesach, shekkol zeman shello hiprishu hammiddot lo zaka bahen hayyisrael, shehare lo qana mehammoshel ella hammiddot sheyyaprishu min habbishshulim sheyyebashshelu bayyorot shel hammoshel:

Mi shemmachaziq rechayim mimmoshel hair veyesh lo choq qabua mehammoshel al kol bene hair shekkol mi sheyyitchon tebua berechayim ellu yitten lo midda achat qemach miqqemach hannitchan — dino bepesach leinyan techinat tebua mechummetzet sheqqorin (mal"tz) kedin mi shemmachaziq yorot leinyan bishshule chametz, ukemo shennitbaer:

Asur litten behemto lenokri lehaakilah bime happesach im yadua lo shehannokri yaakilenna pesolet shel seorim shehu chametz, lepi sheakilat habbehema hi hanaat haadam, sheal yede ken hi mitalla umeshabbachat umitvassepet bedamim. Veap al pi sheim hayeta okelet debarim acherim sheenan chametz hayeta gam ken mitalla umeshabbachat, mikkol maqom akshav sheshshebach veilluy zeh ba lah al yede chametz bepesach — hare zeh asur ap al pi shehechametz hu shel nokri. (Veayyen beyoreh dea siman s' vesiman qm"b sheim abar hayyisrael veheekilah beatzmo chametz bepesach, shemmuttar leshachatah uleoklah bepesach, veen tzarik lehashlik deme hanaat hechametz leibbud, ayyen sham hattaam). Umikkol maqom, im en yadua lo bevadday sheyyaakilenna chametz — muttar littenah lo, veen chosheshin shemma yaakilenna chametz:

Abal muttar lomar bepesach leabdo nokri: "helak dinar zeh uqeneh veekol", ap al pi shehu yodea shehaebed yelek veyiqneh chametz veyokal, lepi sheakilat haebed enah chashuba hanaa lerabbo kemo akilat habbehema, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rk"a:

Abal lo yomar adam bepesach lenokri, ben shehu abdo ben sheeno abdo: "helak dinar zeh uqeneh leka chametz min hachenvani veekol", dekevan shehayyisrael beatzmo asur lo liqnot chametz bepesach — asur lo lomar lenokri liqnoto. Veap al pi shehannokri qoneh oto leatzmo velo bishbil hayyisrael, mikkol maqom kevan shehayyisrael noten dinar lehannokri veomer lo sheyyiqneh bo chametz vehannokri qoneh oto bedibburo shel yisrael — hare zeh nireh kishlucho, mittaam shennitbaer besiman sh"z. Abal muttar lomar lo: "qeneh leka chametz bedinar shelleka veekol":

Veken muttar lomar bepesach lenokri, apillu hu abdo shemmezonotayv alayv: "lek veqach alay chametz min hachenvani veekol vaani epra lo". Umuttar lo liproa lachenvani apillu beod shehechametz baolam sheadayin lo akalo haebed, veen hechametz niqneh leyisrael beperaon zeh, kevan shebbeshaa zo en hechametz beyad hayyisrael ella beyad haebed. (Veap al pi shehaebed hinniach hechametz bachatzero shel hayyisrael, mikkol maqom en chatzero shel adam qona lo dabar sheen noach lo, kegon chametz bepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"ch). Vegam beshaa shemmashak haebed et hechametz min hachenvani lo nitkavven bimshikato ella lizkot bo leatzmo velo bishbil hayyisrael. Vegam hachenvani nitkavven lehaqnot hechametz lehaebed bimshikato velo lehayyisrael, raq sheyyachazor al hayyisrael sheyyipra lo bead abdo, nimtza shechametzo shel chenvani hu sheokel haebed velo chametzo shel hayyisrael rabbo:

Abal asur leyisrael lehaqdim dinar lechenvani nokri velomar lo sheyyitten mezonot leabdo bepesach veachar happesach yaaseh immo cheshbon, shemma yitten lo chametz, vechametz zeh hu shel yisrael, kevan shekkebar natan alayv dinar lehachenvani. (Vaapillu ledibre haomerim sheyyisrael eno qoneh mittaltelin minnokri bekesep bilbad, mikkol maqom kevan shehachenvani kebar qibbel haddinar min hayyisrael hare dato lehaqnot lehayyisrael mezonot keneged dinaro, ukeshehachenvani noten achar kak chametz lehaebed eno noten lo betorat mekirat chametz shello ella betorat netinat chametz shel yisrael, vehu oseh shelichut hayyisrael shetztzivva lo litten mezonot leabdo):

Abal im eno maqdim lo dinar — muttar lomar lo: "ten chametz leabdi vaani epra leka", shekkol shello para lo hayyisrael qodem shennoten hechametz leabdo hare hu noteno lo betorat mekirat chametz shello vehayyisrael yipra lo baado. (Veayyen beyoreh dea siman ql"b sheim hu chayyab litten leabdo mezonot shel chametz veeno yakol liptor et atzmo bemah sheyyitten lo mezonot acherim sheenan chametz beal korcho shel haebed — asur lo lomar lechenvani nokri: "potreni mimmezonot abdi veten lo chametz bepesach vaani epra leka leachar happesach"). Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal yesh omerim shemmechamat chumrot chametz yesh lehachamir shello lomar lenokri bepesach: "qeneh leka chametz min hachenvani vaani epra l[o]". Veen tzarik lomar shello yomar lachenvani: "ten chametz lenokri zeh vaani epra leka". Vetob lachosh ledibrehem:

Lepikak, mi sheyyesh lo tinoq choleh qetzat shehu tzarik leekol o lishtot chametz — yizzaher shello yomar lenokri: "ten chametz letinoq zeh vaani epra leka", ella yebaqqesh mimmennu sheyyitten hechametz bemattana lehattinoq. Veim i epshar limtzo beqal mi sheyyitten bemattana — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, umuttar liproa lo achar shennatan hechametz leyad hattinoq, o achar shehinniach chametz bebet hayyisrael, shekkebar yatza hechametz mereshut hannokri qodem happeraon velirshut hayyisrael adayin lo ba ap al pi shehinnicho bebeto, sheen chatzero shel adam qona lo beal korcho, vegam hannokri lo makar et hechametz lo ella lehattinoq. Abal asur leqabbel hechametz bayyad min hannokri apillu qodem happeraon, ella im ken zaka bo kebar hattinoq behagbaha, shekkol zeman shello zaka bo hattinoq, apillu hinnicho hannokri bebet hayyisrael vechazar unetalo — hare hu shello keshehaya, ukeshennotelo hayyisrael miyyado — hare zeh keqoneh chametz bepesach:

Vaapillu leachar shezzaka hattinoq bechametz — asur leyisrael gadol lehaakilo ulehashqoto et hechametz, gezera shemma yishkach haggadol al issur chametz veyistappeq mimmennu, shehare apillu ligga bechametz asur mechamat gezera zo, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"v, ella yomar lenokri o leqatan apillu yisrael sheyyaakil veyashqeh et hechametz lehattinoq. Abal muttar lehashhot chametz zeh betok habbayit. Ap al pi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yishkechu veyistappequ mimmennu, mikkol maqom kevan shehattinoq hu choleh vei epshar lehotzio min habbayit, vegam min hassetam i epshar limtzo nokri sheyyabi meat chametz bekol paam upaam sheyyirtzeh hattinoq leekol o lishtot, lepikak hittiru lo lehashhot chametz bebeto bepesach. Umikkol maqom, im epshar tob laasot bipne hechametz mechitztza gaboah asara tepachim, o likpot alayv keli im hu shabbat o yom tob. Vekol zeh keshei epshar limtzo nokri sheyyabi meat meat bekol paam upaam sheyyirtzeh hattinoq leekol velishtot. Veken im i epshar lehaakilo ulehashqoto al yede nokri o qatan — muttar lehaakilo ulehashqoto al yede yisrael gadol. Abal im epshar lehabi lo chametz al yede nokri meat meat bekol paam upaam sheyyirtzeh leekol velishtot — en lehabi harbeh bebat achat. Veim en hattinoq choleh kol kak beinyan shei epshar lehotzio min habbayit — yotziennu mibbeto lebet hannokri vesham yaakiluhu veyashquhu chametz, veal yaknis chametz lebeto kelal:

Vekol zeh becholeh sheen bo sakkana, abal becholeh sheyyesh bo sakkana — en ledaqdeq bekol zeh. Vaapillu liqnot chametz min hashshuq muttar kede lemaher baakilato im hu tzarik laakilat chametz, veen chosheshin lelav shel "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" shehaqqoneh et hechametz ober alayv, sheen leka dabar sheomed bipne piqquach nepesh, veal derek shennitbaer besiman shk"ch ubeyoreh dea siman qn"h ayyen sham:

Asur lihyot shaliach lenokri liqnot lo chametz bepesach apillu bemaotayv shel nokri, vaapillu eno moshek et hechametz mereshut hammoker ella noten lo damim bilbad bepesach, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyisrael qoneh mittaltelin minnokri bekesep bilbad, venimtza shehechametz niqneh lehayyisrael bepesach, veober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veap al pi shehu meparesh lehammoker sheeno qoneh et hechametz leatzmo ella bishbil hannokri sheshshelacho, ap al pi ken niqneh hechametz leyisrael shennatan hammaot miyyado leyad hammoker. Veen omerim kevan shehammaot hen shel nokri vehayyisrael netanam bishlichuto hare zeh keillu netanam hannokri beatzmo, sheen omerim "shelucho shel adam kemoto" ella beyisrael shennaaseh shaliach leyisrael chabero, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qp"ch.
